Fixtures captured from the English FCI website on 22 October 2026. HTML fixtures retain the nomenclature content and omit navigation outside it. `catalogue.json` is an offline test dataset built from successfully captured pages. Four provisional detail pages (351, 360, 361, 362) timed out during capture and are excluded from this test dataset; it must not be used as a production catalogue. All captured source URLs and the capture timestamp are recorded in the snapshot. Production always requires every discovered breed to finish enrichment before exporting.
